summary: KE Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BEKE) filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, attaching Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong listing rules. These returns detail ongoing open-market share repurchases conducted from 22 May to 10 July 2026. Thousands of shares were bought back daily in both HKD and USD tranches at varying prices; nearly 5.56 million shares have been repurchased but not yet cancelled. The program demonstrates the issuer’s active capital return to shareholders via buybacks. Watch for further repurchase announcements and eventual cancellation of these shares, which could support earnings per share over time.
